### Davidic Covenant II
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/davidic-covenant-ii
Passage: Amos 9:11
Points:
- The Davidic covenant pointed to security under righteous rule, yet earthly kings brought idolatry and exile.
- God pledged that David's royal line would be disciplined for sin but never utterly forsaken.
- Amos foresaw that the Lord would repair David's fallen booth and fulfill His covenant promises.
- After centuries of silence, this kingdom arrived unexpectedly through Christ as a spiritual kingdom.
- Human unfaithfulness does not cancel God's sworn oaths; He always honors His promises.
